description: VN redundancy 'lý do là vì' transfer: learners write 'the reason is because', which is circular in English ('the reason ... is that'). Rule en-vietlish-discourse-reason-is-because rewrites 'is/was because' to 'is/was that' ONLY when anchored to a preceding 'the reason' in the same clause, and never before 'because of' (a preposition).
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. 'is because' is perfectly valid without a 'the reason' anchor ('This is because it rained'), and 'the reason is because of X' takes a prepositional phrase, not a clause. Negatives lock the unanchored 'is because', a bare 'because' clause, the 'because of' preposition, and a reason-less sentence.

positive.input: The reason is because I was tired.
positive.expectedCorrection: The reason is that I was tired.

positive.input: The reason why he left is because he was bored.
positive.expectedCorrection: The reason why he left is that he was bored.
positive.notes: Intervening 'why he left' clause preserved; only 'is because' -> 'is that'.

positive.input: The reason was because nobody told me.
positive.expectedCorrection: The reason was that nobody told me.

negative.input: This is because it rained all day.
negative.expectedCorrection: This is because it rained all day.
negative.notes: No 'the reason' anchor: bare 'is because' is correct -> must abstain.

negative.input: I left early because I was tired.
negative.expectedCorrection: I left early because I was tired.
negative.notes: Bare 'because' clause, no 'is because' and no 'the reason' -> must abstain.

negative.input: The reason is because of the rain.
negative.expectedCorrection: The reason is because of the rain.
negative.notes: 'because of' is a preposition; rewriting to 'is that of the rain' would be ungrammatical -> must abstain.

negative.input: The reason is clear to everyone.
negative.expectedCorrection: The reason is clear to everyone.
negative.notes: 'the reason is' with no 'because' -> nothing to rewrite, must abstain.

negative.input: The reason was that I was too tired.
negative.expectedCorrection: The reason was that I was too tired.
negative.notes: Already-correct form: 'the reason was that' has no 'because' to rewrite; must stay unchanged.

negative.input: A reason he gave was because he was bored.
negative.expectedCorrection: A reason he gave was because he was bored.
negative.notes: Indefinite article 'a reason': pattern anchors on 'the reason' (definite); 'a reason' must not trigger.

negative.input: The reasons were because they were too tired.
negative.expectedCorrection: The reasons were because they were too tired.
negative.notes: Plural 'reasons': \b after 'reason' requires a non-word char; 'reasons' has 's' next, breaking the word boundary; must not match.

negative.input: Is the reason because you were late?
negative.expectedCorrection: Is the reason because you were late?
negative.notes: Inverted question: the copula 'is' comes before 'the reason' in the string; the pattern needs 'the reason ... is/was because' order so the inverted form falls outside scope.

negative.input: The reason for her absence was not because of laziness.
negative.expectedCorrection: The reason for her absence was not because of laziness.
negative.notes: 'was not because': 'not' intervenes between 'was ' and 'because', breaking the required 'was [space] because' adjacency; must abstain.

negative.input: That is because it was raining heavily.
negative.expectedCorrection: That is because it was raining heavily.
negative.notes: No 'the reason' anchor — 'That is because' is a different demonstrative surface; must abstain.
